verdict.rationale: Rendering strategy and DOM debuggability are fair axes for a UI framework, so the story applies. However, nothing in the pack documents that Vue's output can be inspected or debugged in browser devtools. 'Builds on top of standard HTML, CSS and JavaScript' is a general positioning claim, and the custom-renderer and custom-element pages cover different features, so none of these transfer to this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can debug my UI directly in browser devtools because the framework renders real DOM nodes
